title: Shards in the Sink
style: Chillwave jazz with a laid-back swung groove, soft brushed drums, warm electric piano, upright bass murmurs, and delayed guitar glints; verse floats with intimate close-mic vocals and light harmony doubles, pre-chorus thins to keys and bass, chorus opens with stacked ooohs and a short chantable hook. Add reversed glass swells, tape hiss, and a subtle sidechain pulse. Dreamy, airy, and satin-smooth mix., chillwave, jazz
lyrics:
[Verse 1]
I found you by the sink
In a silver crack
One clean face gone thin
But it still stared back

Tiny cuts on my hand
From the careful light
You showed me all my edges
In a quiet bite

[Pre-Chorus]
Now every little angle
Tells me what I hid
Every broken corner
Got a place to live

[Chorus]
Broken mirror, broken mirror
Tell me what you saw
Broken mirror, broken mirror
I was there for all of it
(Broken mirror)
I was there for all of it

[Verse 2]
Mama said don't touch it
Let the pieces sleep
But I watched the table
Hold my face in three

One piece kept the smile
One kept the bruise
One kept all the reasons
I was scared to lose

[Pre-Chorus]
Now every little angle
Tells me what I hid
Every broken corner
Got a place to live

[Chorus]
Broken mirror, broken mirror
Tell me what you saw
Broken mirror, broken mirror
I was there for all of it
(Broken mirror)
I was there for all of it

[Bridge]
Maybe I'm not ruined
Maybe I'm divided
Maybe every fracture
Kept the truth inside it
Oh, the light still finds me
Through the hurt I gave
Even in the splinters
There's a face I can save

[Chorus]
Broken mirror, broken mirror
Tell me what you saw
Broken mirror, broken mirror
I was there for all of it
(Broken mirror)
I was there for all of it
